title: PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.32830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. translated_title: PtychoFM：一个用于叠层衍射成像的基础模型
translated_abstract: 叠层衍射成像技术可在X射线、电子和光学显微领域提供高分辨率无透镜成像，但从衍射测量数据重建图像通常需要计算量极大的迭代相位恢复算法。这些方法往往依赖针对特定实验的分析流程，随着数据采集速率的提升，难以实现实时反馈。在此，我们提出了PtychoFM，一种物理感知的叠层衍射成像基础模型，它将大规模预训练与针对特定实验的微调相结合，能够直接从单个衍射图样重建复数物体图像。PtychoFM使用可微正向模型进行训练，无需物体空间的标签，能够从在一个样品上的步进扫描训练数据迁移到具有不同特征尺寸、形貌和折射率的其他样品的飞行扫描测量。在同步辐射光束线上，衍射帧从探测器流式传输至单个GPU进行推理。
tldr: PtychoFM是一种物理感知的叠层衍射成像基础模型，通过可微正向模型在大规模数据上预训练并针对具体实验微调，无需物体空间标签即可直接从单个衍射图样重建图像，并能跨样品与扫描方式迁移，在同步辐射装置上实现实时推理。
en_tdlr: PtychoFM is a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that reconstructs object images directly from individual diffraction patterns—without object-space labels—transfers across samples and scan modes, and enables real-time inference at synchrotron beamlines.
